subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------SOC.RT.P.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-20 (Social Reality and Trans-Information, Level Two), on the page where Braxton argues that 'the realness of history is important for providing the necessary backdrop to develop the character and confidence of young people' — citing the example that even in the late sixties the only great figures black people could study in grammar and high school were George Washington Carver and Booker T. Washington. (R)INFO-DS (the reality of information dissemination) is crossed with SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars): the question is what real dissemination produces when crossed with social-reality-particulars in a culture where history itself is selectively curated. The partner SOC-RT-P is the structural endpoint. (R)CULT-INFO-FO (the reality of culture information focus) branches from the main line, and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from (R)CULT-INFO-FO. AF-DY carries IST-ACT (isolated activism) and PR-TR. PR-TR carries DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), which carries ALT-C-PROG (alternative composite progressionalism), and a *dashed* line to INFO-DOC (information documentation), which amplifies some aspect of PR-TR.
